text_en: The second lot came out for Simeon, for the tribe of Simeon, according to its families; its inheritance lay within the inheritance of the tribe of Judah.
text_cn: 西默盎，即西默盎支派子孙，按照家族得了第二签，他们的土地是在犹大子孙的产业内。

text_en: It had for its inheritance Beer-sheba, Sheba, Moladah,
text_cn: 他们分得的产业：是贝尔舍巴、舍玛，摩拉达、

text_en: Hazar-shual, Balah, Ezem,
text_cn: 哈匝尔叔阿耳、巴拉、厄曾、

text_en: Eltolad, Bethul, Hormah,
text_cn: 厄耳托拉得、贝突耳、曷尔玛、

text_en: Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susah,
text_cn: 漆刻拉格、贝特玛尔加波特、哈匝尔稣撒、

text_en: Beth-lebaoth, and Sharuhen—thirteen towns with their villages;
text_cn: 贝特肋巴敖特和沙鲁恒：共计十三座城和所属村镇；

text_en: Ain, Rimmon, Ether, and Ashan—four towns with their villages;
text_cn: 阿殷、黎孟、厄特尔和阿商：共计四座城和所属村镇；

text_en: together with all the villages all around these towns as far as Baalath-beer, Ramah of the Negeb. This was the inheritance of the tribe of Simeon according to its families.
text_cn: 尚有这些城市四周所有的村镇，直到巴阿拉特贝尔，即乃革布的辣玛：以上是西默盎支派子孙，按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: The inheritance of the tribe of Simeon formed part of the territory of Judah; because the portion of the tribe of Judah was too large for them, the tribe of Simeon obtained an inheritance within their inheritance.
text_cn: 西默盎子孙的产业，取自犹大子孙的土地，是因为犹大子孙分得的地区，过于广大，因此西默盎子孙在他们的境内，分得了产业。

text_en: The third lot came up for the tribe of Zebulun, according to its families. The boundary of its inheritance reached as far as Sarid;
text_cn: 则步隆子孙，按照家族，得了第三签，他们领域的界限直达沙杜得。

text_en: then its boundary goes up westward, and on to Maralah, and touches Dabbesheth, then the wadi that is east of Jokneam;
text_cn: 由此西上，直达玛尔阿拉，路经达巴舍特和约刻乃罕前面的小河，

text_en: from Sarid it goes in the other direction eastward toward the sunrise to the boundary of Chisloth-tabor; from there it goes to Daberath, then up to Japhia;
text_cn: 再由沙杜得向东转向日出之地，直到基斯罗特大博尔，经多贝辣特，直上至雅非亚；

text_en: from there it passes along on the east toward the sunrise to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin, and going on to Rimmon it bends toward Neah;
text_cn: 由此折东，经加特赫费尔，至依塔卡亲，出黎孟直达乃阿；

text_en: then on the north the boundary makes a turn to Hannathon, and it ends at the valley of Iphtah-el;
text_cn: 再由此北上，转向哈纳通，直达依费塔赫耳山谷。

text_en: and Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idalah, and Bethlehem—twelve towns with their villages.
text_cn: 境内有……卡塔特、纳哈拉耳、史默龙、依德阿拉和贝特肋恒：共计十二座城和所属村镇。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Zebulun, according to its families—these towns with their villages.
text_cn: 这些城和村镇是则步隆子孙按照家族，分得的产业。

text_en: The fourth lot came out for Issachar, for the tribe of Issachar, according to its families.
text_cn: 依撒加尔，即依撒加尔子孙，按照家族，得了第四签。

text_en: Its territory included Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,
text_cn: 他们的领域是：依次勒耳、革稣罗特、叔能、

text_en: Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath,
text_cn: 哈法辣殷、史雍、阿纳哈辣特、

text_en: Rabbith, Kishion, Ebez,
text_cn: 多贝辣特、克史雍、厄贝兹、

text_en: Remeth, En-gannim, En-haddah, Beth-pazzez;
text_cn: 勒默特、恩加宁、恩哈达、贝特帕责兹。

text_en: the boundary also touches Tabor, Shahazumah, and Beth-shemesh, and its boundary ends at the Jordan—sixteen towns with their villages.
text_cn: 边界上还有大博尔、沙哈漆玛、贝特舍默士，直达约但河：共计十六座城和所属村镇。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Issachar, according to its families—the towns with their villages.
text_cn: 这些城和所属村镇，是依撒加尔支派子孙，按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: The fifth lot came out for the tribe of Asher according to its families.
text_cn: 阿协尔支派子孙，按照家族，得了第五签。

text_en: Its boundary included Helkath, Hali, Beten, Achshaph,
text_cn: 他们得的领域是：赫耳卡特、哈里、贝腾、阿革沙弗，

text_en: Allammelech, Amad, and Mishal; on the west it touches Carmel and Shihor-libnath,
text_cn: 阿拉默肋客、阿玛得、米沙耳；西至加尔默耳和里贝纳特河，

text_en: then it turns eastward, goes to Beth-dagon, and touches Zebulun and the valley of Iphtah-el northward to Beth-emek and Neiel; then it continues in the north to Cabul,
text_cn: 然后转向东方，直达贝特达贡，与则步隆和北方的依费塔赫耳山谷相接；再经贝特厄默克和乃耶耳，至加步耳北部；

text_en: Ebron, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, as far as Great Sidon;
text_cn: 再经阿贝冬、勒曷布、哈孟、卡纳、直达漆冬大城；

text_en: then the boundary turns to Ramah, reaching to the fortified city of Tyre; then the boundary turns to Hosah, and it ends at the sea; Mahalab, Achzib,
text_cn: 由此转向辣玛直至左尔坚城，再转向辣玛，直达于海。此外尚有玛哈肋布、阿革齐布，

text_en: Ummah, Aphek, and Rehob—twenty-two towns with their villages.
text_cn: 阿苛、阿费克和勒曷布：共计二十二座城和所属村镇。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Asher according to its families—these towns with their villages.
text_cn: 这些城和村镇，是阿协尔支派子孙，按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: The sixth lot came out for the tribe of Naphtali, for the tribe of Naphtali, according to its families.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里，即纳斐塔里支派子孙，按照家族，得了第六签。

text_en: And its boundary ran from Heleph, from the oak in Zaanannim, and Adami-nekeb, and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum; and it ended at the Jordan;
text_cn: 他们的边界，是起自赫肋弗和匝纳宁橡树，经阿达米乃刻布和雅贝乃耳，直到拉孔，迄于约但河。

text_en: then the boundary turns westward to Aznoth-tabor, and goes from there to Hukkok, touching Zebulun at the south, and Asher on the west, and Judah on the east at the Jordan.
text_cn: 西方边界，由阿次诺特大博尔，直达胡科克，南接则步隆，西接阿协尔。东方以约但河为界。

text_en: The fortified towns are Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth,
text_cn: 设防的城市有漆丁、责尔、哈玛特、辣卡特、基乃勒特、

text_en: Adamah, Ramah, Hazor,
text_cn: 阿达玛、辣玛、哈祚尔、

text_en: Kedesh, Edrei, En-hazor,
text_cn: 卡德士、厄德勒、恩哈祚尔、

text_en: Iron, Migdal-el, Horem, Beth-anath, and Beth-shemesh—nineteen towns with their villages.
text_cn: 依郎、米革达肋耳、曷楞、贝特阿纳特和贝特舍默士：共计十九座城和所属村镇。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Naphtali according to its families—the towns with their villages.
text_cn: 这些城和村镇，是纳斐塔里支派子孙，按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: The seventh lot came out for the tribe of Dan, according to its families.
text_cn: 丹支派子孙，按照家族，得了第七签。

text_en: The territory of its inheritance included Zorah, Eshtaol, Ir-shemesh,
text_cn: 他们分得的领域是：祚辣、厄市陶耳，依尔舍默士、

text_en: Shaalabbin, Aijalon, Ithlah,
text_cn: 沙阿拉宾、阿雅隆、依特拉、

text_en: Elon, Timnah, Ekron,
text_cn: 厄隆、提默纳、厄刻龙。

text_en: Eltekeh, Gibbethon, Baalath,
text_cn: 厄耳特刻、基贝通、巴拉特。

text_en: Jehud, Bene-berak, Gath-rimmon,
text_cn: 耶胡得、贝乃贝辣克、加特黎孟、

text_en: Me-jarkon, and Rakkon at the border opposite Joppa.
text_cn: 默雅尔孔、辣孔和约培对面的地区。

text_en: When the territory of the Danites was lost to them, the Danites went up and fought against Leshem, and after capturing it and putting it to the sword, they took possession of it and settled in it, calling Leshem, Dan, after their ancestor Dan.
text_cn: 但是这地区为丹的子孙过于窄狭，因而丹的子孙上去攻占了肋笙，屠杀了城中的人民，据为己有，住在那里，以他们祖先丹的名字，称肋笙为丹。

text_en: This is the inheritance of the tribe of Dan, according to their families—these towns with their villages.
text_cn: 这些城和村镇，是丹支派子孙按照家族分得的产业。

text_en: When they had finished distributing the several territories of the land as inheritances, the Israelites gave an inheritance among them to Joshua son of Nun.
text_cn: 以色列子民，依照界限分完了产业以后，又在他们中间，分给了农的儿子若苏厄一分产业。

text_en: By command of the Lord they gave him the town that he asked for, Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim; he rebuilt the town, and settled in it.
text_cn: 他们照上主的吩咐，将若苏厄要求的城市，即厄弗辣因山地的提默纳特色辣黑给了他；若苏厄便重建了那城，住在那里。

text_en: These are the inheritances that the priest Eleazar and Joshua son of Nun and the heads of the families of the tribes of the Israelites distributed by lot at Shiloh before the Lord , at the entrance of the tent of meeting. So they finished dividing the land.
text_cn: 以上是司祭厄肋阿匝尔和农的儿子若苏厄，以及以色列子民各支派的族长，在史罗会幕门口，于上主面前，抽签划分土地的记述；分地的事，就这样完成了。
